meta.title: New Wish
meta.description: Bathe in the shining lights and take a new step forward.

units.rawText: Ah! P-Penumbra... when did you get back?

spans.text: Ah! P-Penumbra... when did you get back?

units.rawText: In the corner mostly spared from the reach of sunlight, Penumbra stares at me without a word, mechanically answering Persicaria.

units.rawText: Last night.
units.displayText: Last night.

spans.text: Last night.

units.rawText: Haha, Penumbra did well on the assignment in Helios this time. Uranus' memristor replacement has gone smoothly as well, and I imagine he's taking a well deserved break in the repair bay.
units.displayText: Haha, Penumbra did well on the assignment in Helios this time. Uranus' memristor replacement has gone smoothly as well, and I imagine he's taking a well deserved break in the repair bay.

units.rawText: Will you not go rest, Penumbra?
units.displayText: Will you not go rest, Penumbra?

spans.text: Will you not go rest, Penumbra?

units.rawText: I'm content by the Professor's side. It's more relaxing to me than resting.
units.displayText: I'm content by the Professor's side. It's more relaxing to me than resting.

spans.text: I'm content by the Professor's side. It's more relaxing to me than resting.

units.rawText: Then... did you find the future you were looking for in Helios?
units.displayText: Then... did you find the future you were looking for in Helios?

spans.text: Then... did you find the future you were looking for in Helios?

units.rawText: I did, yes.
units.displayText: I did, yes.

spans.text: I did, yes.

units.rawText: Do tell.
units.displayText: Do tell.

spans.text: Do tell.

units.rawText: As a test Doll discarded by humanity, I had nothing to my name after my employer's death.
units.displayText: As a test Doll discarded by humanity, I had nothing to my name after my employer's death.

spans.text: As a test Doll discarded by humanity, I had nothing to my name after my employer's death.

units.rawText: With no one to give me orders, I often thought that I wasn't needed. Like that, there was no meaning to my existence.
units.displayText: With no one to give me orders, I often thought that I wasn't needed. Like that, there was no meaning to my existence.

spans.text: With no one to give me orders, I often thought that I wasn't needed. Like that, there was no meaning to my existence.

units.rawText: But everything that exists in this world has meaning in and of itself. This is why we have music, the evening sun, the world as we know it.
units.displayText: But everything that exists in this world has meaning in and of itself. This is why we have music, the evening sun, the world as we know it.

spans.text: But everything that exists in this world has meaning in and of itself. This is why we have music, the evening sun, the world as we know it.

units.rawText: Thanks to the Professor, I won't bind myself to any duty, but instead live as my heart dictates.
units.displayText: Thanks to the Professor, I won't bind myself to any duty, but instead live as my heart dictates.

spans.text: Thanks to the Professor, I won't bind myself to any duty, but instead live as my heart dictates.

units.rawText: Seeing as the Professor's gotten through to you, why don't you go and do something you want to?
units.displayText: Seeing as the Professor's gotten through to you, why don't you go and do something you want to?

spans.text: Seeing as the Professor's gotten through to you, why don't you go and do something you want to?

units.rawText: Because protecting the Professor is what my heart dictates.
units.displayText: Because protecting the Professor is what my heart dictates.

spans.text: Because protecting the Professor is what my heart dictates.

units.rawText: Penumbra's expression shows no sign of frivolousness.
units.displayText: Penumbra's expression shows no sign of frivolousness.

spans.text: Penumbra's expression shows no sign of frivolousness.

units.rawText: Persicaria feels an oncoming headache, unable to stop herself from sighing as she puts a hand on her forehead.
units.displayText: Persicaria feels an oncoming headache, unable to stop herself from sighing as she puts a hand on her forehead.

spans.text: Persicaria feels an oncoming headache, unable to stop herself from sighing as she puts a hand on her forehead.

units.rawText: Sigh...
units.displayText: Sigh...

spans.text: Sigh...

units.rawText: Haha, Persicaria, don't worry, I'm sure one of these days...
units.displayText: Haha, Persicaria, don't worry, I'm sure one of these days...

spans.text: Haha, Persicaria, don't worry, I'm sure one of these days...

units.rawText: Thump thump.
units.displayText: Thump thump.

spans.text: Thump thump.

units.rawText: The brisk and rhythmic sound of knocking interrupts the conversation inside.
units.displayText: The brisk and rhythmic sound of knocking interrupts the conversation inside.

spans.text: The brisk and rhythmic sound of knocking interrupts the conversation inside.

units.rawText: Come in.
units.displayText: Come in.

spans.text: Come in.

units.rawText: Professor, Persicaria... and OpsTec, good morning.
units.displayText: Professor, Persicaria... and OpsTec, good morning.

spans.text: Professor, Persicaria... and OpsTec, good morning.

units.rawText: The moment Simo enters the room, the look in Penumbra's eyes hones in.
units.displayText: The moment Simo enters the room, the look in Penumbra's eyes hones in.

spans.text: The moment Simo enters the room, the look in Penumbra's eyes hones in.

units.rawText: Olivia has requested that I head to Cyclopes to assist in combat technique training with the combat Dolls there. The exact details should be in the message she sent to you.
units.displayText: Olivia has requested that I head to Cyclopes to assist in combat technique training with the combat Dolls there. The exact details should be in the message she sent to you.

spans.text: Olivia has requested that I head to Cyclopes to assist in combat technique training with the combat Dolls there. The exact details should be in the message she sent to you.

units.rawText: Ah, about that. I wanted to speak to you about this earlier.
units.displayText: Ah, about that. I wanted to speak to you about this earlier.

spans.text: Ah, about that. I wanted to speak to you about this earlier.

units.rawText: Our field operations were complete a few days ago, and there are no emergency affairs to attend to in the Oasis as of now. If you have no other arrangements, Professor, I can head there in the near future.
units.displayText: Our field operations were complete a few days ago, and there are no emergency affairs to attend to in the Oasis as of now. If you have no other arrangements, Professor, I can head there in the near future.

spans.text: Our field operations were complete a few days ago, and there are no emergency affairs to attend to in the Oasis as of now. If you have no other arrangements, Professor, I can head there in the near future.

units.rawText: By yourself? The Cloud is indeed free of strife as of now, but scattered Entropics still lurk outside the Sector. The calm before the storm, as they say.
units.displayText: By yourself? The Cloud is indeed free of strife as of now, but scattered Entropics still lurk outside the Sector. The calm before the storm, as they say.

spans.text: By yourself? The Cloud is indeed free of strife as of now, but scattered Entropics still lurk outside the Sector. The calm before the storm, as they say.

units.rawText: To be on the safe side, someone should accompany you on this assignment.
units.displayText: To be on the safe side, someone should accompany you on this assignment.

spans.text: To be on the safe side, someone should accompany you on this assignment.

units.rawText: Eh? Ahh... but if it is your decision, you must have your reasons, Professor. I shall follow your arrangements.
units.displayText: Eh? Ahh... but if it is your decision, you must have your reasons, Professor. I shall follow your arrangements.

spans.text: Eh? Ahh... but if it is your decision, you must have your reasons, Professor. I shall follow your arrangements.

units.rawText: Alright. Take a break in the Rest Area for now. I will dispatch someone to go with you in a moment.
units.displayText: Alright. Take a break in the Rest Area for now. I will dispatch someone to go with you in a moment.

spans.text: Alright. Take a break in the Rest Area for now. I will dispatch someone to go with you in a moment.

units.rawText: Simo nods, taking a glance at the on edge Penumbra in the corner, flashing a friendly smile.
units.displayText: Simo nods, taking a glance at the on edge Penumbra in the corner, flashing a friendly smile.

spans.text: Simo nods, taking a glance at the on edge Penumbra in the corner, flashing a friendly smile.

units.displayText: The HQ's doors close once again.

spans.text: The HQ's doors close once again.

units.rawText: Man, what a pain, who do I send with him...
units.displayText: Man, what a pain, who do I send with him...

spans.text: Man, what a pain, who do I send with him...

units.rawText: I scratch my head, sighing and adding some theatrics to the situation.
units.displayText: I scratch my head, sighing and adding some theatrics to the situation.

spans.text: I scratch my head, sighing and adding some theatrics to the situation.

units.rawText: The lad in the corner hesitates for a moment, but speaks up with a red face.
units.displayText: The lad in the corner hesitates for a moment, but speaks up with a red face.

spans.text: The lad in the corner hesitates for a moment, but speaks up with a red face.

units.rawText: Professor, can you send me?
units.displayText: Professor, can you send me?

spans.text: Professor, can you send me?

units.rawText: If you're willing, that would be perfect. Simo's an old friend of yours, and I trust that you will take good care of each other.
units.displayText: If you're willing, that would be perfect. Simo's an old friend of yours, and I trust that you will take good care of each other.

spans.text: If you're willing, that would be perfect. Simo's an old friend of yours, and I trust that you will take good care of each other.

units.rawText: Perhaps friend is not the correct word, but I would be grateful if you were to arrange for me to work with him further...
units.displayText: Perhaps friend is not the correct word, but I would be grateful if you were to arrange for me to work with him further...

spans.text: Perhaps friend is not the correct word, but I would be grateful if you were to arrange for me to work with him further...

units.rawText: Gaul is a legend amongst military Dolls. I desire power and admire those who are strong. To want to work alongside someone such as him then follows.
units.displayText: Gaul is a legend amongst military Dolls. I desire power and admire those who are strong. To want to work alongside someone such as him then follows.

spans.text: Gaul is a legend amongst military Dolls. I desire power and admire those who are strong. To want to work alongside someone such as him then follows.

units.rawText: Of course, if you are in any danger, I shall return at earliest possibility. May I, Professor?
units.displayText: Of course, if you are in any danger, I shall return at earliest possibility. May I, Professor?

spans.text: Of course, if you are in any danger, I shall return at earliest possibility. May I, Professor?

units.rawText: This is the first request you've ever made of me. How could I say no?
units.displayText: This is the first request you've ever made of me. How could I say no?

spans.text: This is the first request you've ever made of me. How could I say no?

units.rawText: Make sure you tell me what's on your mind from now on. Your future belongs to you and no one else.
units.displayText: Make sure you tell me what's on your mind from now on. Your future belongs to you and no one else.

spans.text: Make sure you tell me what's on your mind from now on. Your future belongs to you and no one else.

units.rawText: If you're ready, go and speak with Simo. We shouldn't keep him waiting.
units.displayText: If you're ready, go and speak with Simo. We shouldn't keep him waiting.

spans.text: If you're ready, go and speak with Simo. We shouldn't keep him waiting.

units.rawText: Penumbra nods, and his steps out of the room are lively.
units.displayText: Penumbra nods, and his steps out of the room are lively.

spans.text: Penumbra nods, and his steps out of the room are lively.

units.rawText: The door closes once more, and I am left alone with Persicaria.
units.displayText: The door closes once more, and I am left alone with Persicaria.

spans.text: The door closes once more, and I am left alone with Persicaria.

units.rawText: Ah, he didn't tell me again to never accept coffee from strangers like before. I almost miss it, honestly.
units.displayText: Ah, he didn't tell me again to never accept coffee from strangers like before. I almost miss it, honestly.

spans.text: Ah, he didn't tell me again to never accept coffee from strangers like before. I almost miss it, honestly.

units.rawText: Hehe, seems you've found yourself in the position of a parent again.
units.displayText: Hehe, seems you've found yourself in the position of a parent again.

spans.text: Hehe, seems you've found yourself in the position of a parent again.

units.rawText: Are you not worried the two of them may clash though? In the real world, they've crossed blades before during their assassination missions.
units.displayText: Are you not worried the two of them may clash though? In the real world, they've crossed blades before during their assassination missions.

spans.text: Are you not worried the two of them may clash though? In the real world, they've crossed blades before during their assassination missions.

units.rawText: Since they've already both moved on from their past, we need not worry about the strife of yesterday.
units.displayText: Since they've already both moved on from their past, we need not worry about the strife of yesterday.

spans.text: Since they've already both moved on from their past, we need not worry about the strife of yesterday.

units.rawText: In the real world, whether their encounters are brief or intense, they were merely influenced by their positions.
units.displayText: In the real world, whether their encounters are brief or intense, they were merely influenced by their positions.

spans.text: In the real world, whether their encounters are brief or intense, they were merely influenced by their positions.

units.rawText: If they get along right off the bat in the Oasis, then they should have a fantastic time getting to know each other.

units.displayText: The Oasis, Rest Area.

units.rawText: Croque and Simo passionately discuss a mecha anime that ended yesterday, the sunlight before them suddenly obscured by a shadow.

units.rawText: ...Like I was saying, the ending was the dumbest thing I've ever seen. How did they end up deciding to kill the main character? It's infuriating!
